in_sanskrit.name: Marak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mara, the God of Death
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Marak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Marak is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mara', which refers to the God of Death in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to bestow the bearer with courage, protection, and strength, as the God Mara is known to vanquish all fears and adversities.
